name: Sellkey
tagline: A snippet keyboard for quick replies: save the messages, price quotes, images and files you send often, then paste them in any app with one tap — works offline.
storage_summary: Your keys, folders, images, files, clipboard history and settings are stored only on your iPhone. The Sellkey keyboard has no network access. The only data that leaves your iPhone is anonymous usage counting from the main app, which never includes anything you type, save or paste.
nothing_sent_detail: The text, images and files in your keys, everything you paste, your clipboard history and your profile details are never sent anywhere.

google_analytics.name: Google Analytics for Firebase
google_analytics.purpose: Counts how the main app is used (for example whether setup was finished or a feature was opened) so we can fix problems and improve Sellkey. Not used for advertising or cross-app tracking. The keyboard itself contains no analytics.
google_analytics.data: event names and counts (never the content of your keys, clipboard or anything you type), an app-instance identifier, app version, device model, OS version, locale, approximate region derived from your IP address

apple_storekit.name: Apple (App Store purchases)
apple_storekit.purpose: Processes the one-time Sellkey Pro purchase and verifies that you own it.
apple_storekit.data: your purchase receipt, handled by Apple. We never see your payment details, Apple Account or name.

data_sent.what: Anonymous usage events from the main app (never your keys, clipboard or typing), app-instance identifier, app and device info, approximate region
data_sent.why: Understand how the app is used and improve it
Confirm that you own Sellkey Pro

stored_on_device: Your keys (text, price quotes, images, files, bank-transfer QR details), folders, pins and recently used keys.
Clipboard history saved by the keyboard (only when you turn on Full Access), which expires after the time you choose in Settings.
Backups go only to a file or folder you choose (for example in Files or iCloud Drive); we never receive them.
Delete everything at any time by deleting the app.
not_collected: Your name, email address or any account, because Sellkey has no sign-in.
Anything you type with the Sellkey keyboard, and the content of your keys, clipboard or pasted items — none of it leaves your iPhone.
Your advertising identifier (IDFA), precise location, contacts or browsing history. Sellkey does not track you across apps and never shows the App Tracking Transparency prompt.
Crash reports, because the app includes no crash-reporting SDK.
Payment details — Sellkey Pro is bought through Apple, and we never see your card, Apple Account or name.

permissions.name: Keyboard Full Access (optional)
permissions.why: lets the keyboard copy images and files for you to paste, keep your clipboard history and share usage order with the app. Everything stays on your iPhone and the keyboard has no network access. Text keys work without Full Access.

permissions.name: Face ID
permissions.why: only to reveal keys you have marked as hidden. Face ID data is handled by iOS and never reaches the app.

your_controls: **Turn Full Access on or off** in iOS Settings → General → Keyboard → Keyboards → Sellkey. Text keys keep working without it.
**Clear clipboard history** and keyboard activity in Settings → What the keyboard did.
**Delete any key**; deleted keys stay in Recently Deleted for 30 days, then are removed for good.
**Delete all your data** by deleting the app.

support_faq.q: How do I turn on the Sellkey keyboard?
support_faq.a: Open iOS Settings → General → Keyboard → Keyboards → Add New Keyboard and choose **Sellkey**. Then, in any app, hold the globe key and pick Sellkey. The setup screen in the app walks you through it and lets you try a key.

No. Text keys, fill-in fields, variables and price quotes work without it. Full Access is only needed to paste images and files, keep a clipboard history and learn which keys you use most. Even with Full Access the keyboard has no network access and your data stays on your iPhone.

support_faq.q: Why can't I see Sellkey in some text fields?
support_faq.a: iOS switches to the system keyboard in password fields and some secure fields, and some apps block third-party keyboards. Tap the field again or switch back with the globe key.

support_faq.q: Is Sellkey free? What does Sellkey Pro add?
support_faq.a: Sellkey is free with up to 12 keys, no ads. **Sellkey Pro** is a one-time purchase — no subscription — that adds unlimited keys, Paste Stack and bank-transfer QR keys. Keys you already have always stay viewable, pasteable and exportable.

support_faq.q: How do I restore Sellkey Pro?
support_faq.a: Tap **Restore Purchases** on the Sellkey Pro screen. Make sure you are signed in with the same Apple Account you used to buy.

support_faq.q: How do I move my keys to a new iPhone?
support_faq.a: In Settings → Backup, export a backup file and import it on the new iPhone, or turn on automatic backup to a folder you choose.

support_faq.q: How do I get a refund?
support_faq.a: Refunds are handled by Apple. Request one at [reportaproblem.apple.com](https://reportaproblem.apple.com).
